rules.cell_area_rule: transform each HRAP cell polygon to EPSG:6566 before measuring physical intersection area
rules.partial_cell_rule: weight precipitation by exact intersection area with the stage-specific reservoir geometry
rules.nodata_rule: reject if any reservoir-intersecting observation cell is nodata
rules.band_rule: use observation band only; normal/departure/percent-normal bands are not precipitation depth
rules.timestamp_rule: preserve NOAA data_time and creation_time verbatim; a real balance requires explicit mapping to the selected hourly interval
rules.qpe_uncertainty_rule: numeric QPE uncertainty is required for admission; the frozen public sample does not by itself supply a per-cell uncertainty
